name: Gialla Deacair

attributes.attribute: used the name Gialla Deacair to trick the Fianna

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gialla Deacair, also called Gilla Dacker, is a redirect entry. The name means 'lazy servant.' Abarta took this name when he tricked the Fianna into mounting his frail horse and carried them off. For the full story, see the entry s.v. ABARTA.

okr.objective: Keep Gialla Deacair as a short redirect cross-reference to ABARTA.
